answer.says: The state requires the vouchers of the public servant to be distinct from his particular existence; yet here, my particular existence is the only source of funds, and the state refuses to admit the distinction. I have paid the queried sum of ₹270. I shall return on the 20th for the file, as ordered.
answer.thought: The friction between the universal claim of the state and the particular reality of my pocket is absolute. I have paid the queried amount, but the system remains a wall that does not yield to reason, only to procedure. My hunger is a particular that the office has not yet processed.
